case_name: Rama Devi v State of Bihar and others
holding: The Appellant, Rama Devi, cannot be made responsible for the circumstances which followed the sale effected by the Appellant in favour of the Respondent No.2 and the filing of such a criminal complaint was nothing more than an attempt to pressurize the Appellant into making a settlement.
The appeal succeeds and is allowed.
cases_cited: Rama Devi v State of Bihar
